description: Rank history for a product's tracked keywords, as checked by the scanner on its scan passes: per keyword the latest position (null = checked and not in the top-10), best position, and the series of stored checks. Only positions actually checked are returned — never interpolated. searchConfigured=false means no SERP source (Treg/Tavily) is configured and the scanner skips checks, so the board stays empty until the admin configures one. Requires a plan with the keyword_research facility
name: get_keyword_ranks
